tagged_history_allows_rewrite_of_uncovered_fragments uses fragments0..6, paired FRI bits and reserved entry bitmap{0}; bare Rewrite replaces fragment5 with10 and carries no new FRI snapshot. Successful build retains some final index with original FRI UUID. It asserts neither full metadata equality nor output fragment IDs; uncovered physical rewrite is the supported counterpart to covered bare-rewrite rejection.

out_of_range_transition_source_id_rejected passes reordered_sources a transition source u32::MAX+1, four physical rows, zero deletions, no destinations/mapping. unwrap_err message must contain row address range wording. Pins checked conversion; does not assert a particular Error variant.

tagged_history_allows_rewrite_appending_tagged_entry supplies current reserved entry dataset_version7 and prepared FragReuseUpdate::Rewrite with new entry, base_entry_version Some7 and empty reordered_sources. Rewrite groups and rewritten indices are empty. prepare_indices_with_inputs succeeds; build_manifest_prepared must yield one reserved entry with new UUID and reader FRI bit set. Synthetic assembled intent bypasses actual transition assembly/IO; does not assert writer bit or CAS publication.

frag_reuse_rewrite_guards_base_entry_version uses current dataset_version7 but assembled rewrite base_entry_version None. Preparation succeeds, prepared build fails InvalidInput with rebuild text. Tests Option-version mismatch, not full manifest identity/content comparison.

Three prepare_indices_keeps_original_and_withdraws_prepared cases Update/Merge/DataReplacement rewrite field0 on live fragment0. Original translating bitmap{5} with FRI history5->0 and6->8, unrelated other_idx{6}; prepare binds manifest version, preserves entire original metadata array, empties translating prepared bitmap, preserves unrelated bitmap. build_manifest_prepared final indices must equal prepared vector exactly. No persisted index IO or scan is exercised.

Three untagged Update/Merge/DataReplacement cases clear both FRI flags, start segment bitmap{0,3}, rewrite field0 on fragment0 and call prepare_indices only. Original entry remains exact and prepared bitmap becomes{3}; no final build is called in this test.

prepare_indices_restore_and_non_rewrites_are_identity loops Restore(version1), empty Append, Delete(fragment0) and helper Update with no modified fields against tagged manifest+translating/FRI entries. All preparation results retain original vector. Restore here never enters build_manifest's unreachable arm; only preparation identity is asserted.

prepare_indices_external_history_needs_the_supplied_ledger first decodes inline FRI, then removes copied entry.index_details. Preparation without ledger fails InvalidInput; supplying earlier Arc ledger succeeds and empties user bitmap. Despite test name, fixture has absent Any rather than ExternalFile descriptor: it proves caller-ledger use for missing details, not an external read or ledger identity check.

prepare_indices_corrupt_inline_details_is_an_error retains Any type URL but replaces bytes with five0xff. Both prepare_indices and build_manifest must return CorruptFile; corruption is not treated as missing/no lineage. No external history loading is involved.

Prepared-against-another-manifest test prepares against current then increments cloned manifest.version. build_manifest_prepared must fail InvalidInput containing prepared against. It does not test same-version changed fragments/indices, which the numeric binding alone cannot distinguish.

build_manifest_prepared_still_runs_the_gate constructs an unassembled tagged Rewrite snapshot with changed UUID and asserts both prepare_indices and build_manifest fail with assembled by commit path text. Despite name/doc, fixture never directly invokes build_manifest_prepared; its own gate is established by runtime source593-611, not this test call sequence.

sample_manifest_with_fragments creates a nonnullable Int32 id Arrow/Lance schema, Fragment::new for every supplied u64 range element, V2_0 storage and empty bases. Fragments contain no physical-row count or data files; this is a manifest metadata helper.

CreateIndex same-name preservation test starts first+second vector_idx entries, adds third and removes second UUID. Final length2 must contain first/third and exclude second. Removal is UUID-specific even when names match; no data/index payload writes occur.

CreateIndex relisted UUID test starts first+second, adds first+third and removes second. Final length2, first appears once, third present and second absent. Covers deduplication between retained old and supplied new entries, not duplicate UUIDs within the new vector.

Update replacement/removal fixture starts IDs0..5, removes1, supplies updated2 physical42,4 physical43 and absent99. Successful final IDs[0,2,3,4] and physical counts[None,42,None,43] prove replacements of existing entries and ignoring updated ID99; new vector empty and optional mode/offset data absent.

Projected-files Update test has three modes None/RewriteRows/RewriteColumns crossed with spilled-lineage false/true: six cases. Starts fragments0..3; spilled variant sets paired stable flags/next_row_id126, 42 physical rows each and disjoint inline ID ranges. These are in-memory fixtures, not writes.

Projected-files fixture gives fragment1 a retained field0 V2_0 file; staged updated image also contains dropped field1. New placeholder fragment0 similarly contains field0 and field1 files, both staged physical42. Expected file vectors initially contain only projected field0 base files.

Spilled-lineage variant sets row-ID/created/latest metadata to Column and appends three separate carrier files with reserved fields-3/-4/-5 at column0; expected vectors preserve those files. Paths lineage-{reservedid}.lance are fixtures, no hidden columns are loaded or validated against actual bytes here.

Projected-files Update supplies staged updated/new fragments, fields_modified[1], selected mode and empty compacted/preservation vectors. Build with default config must keep only expected field0 plus optional hidden carriers in existing position1 and new position3, preserve physical42 and manifest max_field_id0. Current stable flags can remain active even when default config.use_stable_row_ids is false.

Delete rebasing test uses current manifest version2, fragment2 projected field0 file, overlayfield0@2 and uniform latest2/physical42. Staged read-version1 image includes dropped field1 plus new Array deletion file and deletes fragments1/3. Build yields IDs0,2,4, merges deletion metadata into current fragment, preserves only projected file, current overlay@2, physical42, max_field_id0 and all latest versions2. No deletion file IO or conflict resolver is run.

remove_tombstoned_data_files fixture gives four raw V2_0 files: fields[1,2,3], all[-2,-2,-2], mixed[4,-2,5], all[-2] with sizes1000/500/750/250. Direct helper retains normal then mixed only. This checks metadata pruning, not disk deletion; empty field lists and other negative IDs are not tested here.

Partial RewriteColumns Update has five stable IDs/physical rows but no created/latest metadata, updates same fragment and supplies offsets{1,3}. Successful candidate must still have latest metadata None, preventing fabrication of prior versions. The fixture asserts latest only, not created metadata.

Bitmap cardinality test uses five physical rows with uniform created/latest1 and supplies offsets0..10 to RewriteColumns Update. Build must error with cardinality substring; no Error variant is asserted. Separately bounds number of offsets before maximum-offset validation.
